stem:
Tara compares the two angles in the figure. Angle P has short arms and a wide turn. Angle Q has long arms and a narrow turn.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Angle Q is larger, because its arms are drawn longer.
The drawn arm lengths are what produce the amount of turn.
Angle P is larger, because it has the greater amount of turn about the vertex.
Compare decorative arrowheads on the rays before measuring the turn.

teacher.key_rationale: Angle size is the amount of turn about the vertex, not arm length. Longer arms omit that condition. Arm length does not produce turn. Decorative marks are outside the hinge.
teacher.figure_note: Angle P with short arms and wide opening; angle Q with long arms and narrow opening.
